plan: Add content discovery for scientific topics by extracting topics from video descriptions, creating a DiscoverScreen to browse and filter by topic, and implementing tab-based navigation between Home and Discover screens to help users find scientific content more easily.
steps: Add topics: List<String> field to VideoItem data class to store scientific topics from each video
Update GetFeedUseCase to extract hashtags from video descriptions as topics (parse #hashtag from description strings)
Create GetTopicsUseCase to extract unique topics across all videos in the feed
Create DiscoverViewModel to manage topic selection and filtered video list state
Create DiscoverScreen UI with topic chip list for filtering and videos matching selected topic
Create DiscoverUiState data class to hold available topics, selected topic, and filtered videos
Add Navigation Compose dependency to gradle/libs.versions.toml and app/build.gradle.kts
Update MainActivity to use NavHost with tab-based navigation between HomeScreen and DiscoverScreen
Update HomeViewModel to support optional topic filtering parameter when loading feed
Verify unit tests still pass and add new tests for topic extraction and filtering logic
